(désistement potentiel)

sharedPost.text:
Suite à un potentiel désistement, je recherche de nouveau une personne pour passer sur scène.
Si la personne vient, nous seront 3 au lieu de 2 ce qui ne pose pas souci.

Passage sur scène AUJOURD'HUI de 5 à 10 min
Improvisation sur le thème de la famille Adams
Je viendrai avec mon chien Spinelle
Non rémunéré

Passage à 15h

Réponse attendue avant 14h30 

Lieu : salle polyvalente rue des Réfractaires et des Maquisards
Isle Jourdain (32)

Contactez moi uniquement par téléphone ou SMS au 0780501080

Tenue noire, majeur non protégé (pas de tutelle, curatelle) 

Peu importe le genre (homme /femme /...) , l'âge du moment où vous avez plus de 18 ans.

We are casting for a Hostel Life TV Drama!
The story is set in Manchester where Jessica has just taken a break from her 8 year relationship with Hugo. She wants to regain her independence, so she spontaneously books a hostel somewhere she’s never been.  

Here she encounters a number of characters who teach her how to live freely. At the end Hugo proposes to her, she must decide whether to stick to this new found freedom or revert back to the comfort of her old boyfriend. 

The next character we are looking to cast is 

Ryan:

Ryan: 18-25, Male, English Accent (open to other accents) 

Ryan is the eye candy of the hostel, loves a party and very flirty with guests but not cocky. Ryan works at the hostel so will be an important character. 

Future casting will include Jessica’s ex boyfriend and other extra characters from hostel. If you would like to send an email to be considered for future roles please do not hesitate. 

INFORMATION:

FILMING: 4th, 5th & 10th October but future dates will be required, these are TBC and we can be flexible. 

LOCATION: TBC Manchester based for every date of filming 

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN: As this is a student project it will be unpaid but are happy to give you the episodes for reels. 

TO APPLY: Please email a showreel of your acting with a headshot to 

poppymortimer03@gmail.com

Szukamy chłopców czarnoskórych i o urodzie południowoazjatyckiej (South Asian) w wieku 5-17 lat do odgrywania scenek na nagrania/badania w Warszawie (Białołęka) w terminie 02.11-06.11.

1. Czas nagrania około 1 godziny. Dokładna data i godziny do uzgodnienia.

2. Wynagrodzenie za udział dziecka: 300 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po zleceniu — BLIK/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania i spełnienia wymagań, prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia dziecka, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy do rodzica

5. Adres e-mail do rodzica

6. Wzrost

7. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Nagrania-Scenki

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w projekcie zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

ŚLĄSK I OKOLICE...
Do 2 sezonu GLINIARZE ŚLĄSK, odcinek "muzyczny":) szukam:

Roman Hoffman (42)–gitarzysta bluesowy, w 1 scenie gra na gitarze. Długie włosy. Charyzmatyczny romantyk, trudny w relacjach biznesowych. Dawniej zmagał się z narkotykami. 

nagranie 3 i 6.11

stawka 600 zł za dzień

Tomasz Napiórowski „Napiór” (39)–diler narkotyków. Cwaniacki, bezczelny, pewny siebie i obyty z policją. Dobra sylwetka, wygląd człowieka z półświatka. Ubiera się wygodnie, ale modnie.

nagranie 5.11

stawka 800 zł

Krzysztof Adamski (39) –znany wokalista. Charyzmatyczny, pewny siebie, dumny. Zadbany, ubrany w stylu boho.

nagranie 3.11

stawka 600 zł, 1 scena

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o zgłoszenie na email obsadaolga@gmail.com

Zgłoszenie musi zawierać imię, nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, aktualne zdjęcie demo lub wizytówkę.

W tytule proszę wpisać wybraną postać.

🎬 CASTING CALL — ACTOR NEEDED FOR STUDENT SHORT FILM (£50)
Hi everyone! We are looking for an actor to play George in a university short film project for London Metropolitan University.

About the project:

Cause and Effect is a short film created as part of our university course. The script is very simple and easy to follow.

ROLE: GEORGE (18/19 years old)

• Male actor

• George is Deaf and communicates with his mother through British Sign Language (BSL)

• The role is very simple — George only has one sentence in the entire film

• BSL guidance will be provided

📅 Filming: This Saturday only

⏰ 10:00am – 1:00pm

📍 London

💷 £50 expenses/compensation

This is a student production for London Metropolitan University, and it is a great opportunity to gain experience working on a short film and add the project to your portfolio/showreel.

If you are interested, please DM me with a recent photo and a little information about yourself/your acting experience.

Feel free to tag or share with anyone who might be interested! 🎥

​Massima disponibilità per provini, self-tape ed eventuali trasferte o spostamenti. Su richiesta, sono pronto a inviarvi showreel, foto e curriculum dettagliato.

CASTING NOTICE: MOUNT VERNON’S FAVORITE SON

I am excited to announce that we are now casting day players for our independent short film, Mount Vernon's Favorite Son.

We are seeking performers of any experience who are ready to bring professionalism and energy to the set. This is an excellent opportunity for actors and non-actors looking to build their resume and collaborate with a passionate local production team based in Mount Vernon, New York.

Available Roles: Dialogue-driven rideshare/taxi passengers. For various ages and backgrounds. 

Submission Process: Please email mountvernonsfavoriteson@gmail.com with your headshot, resume, portfolio, and especially any skill sets you'd like to show off. Skills can include musical or dance, or vocational backgrounds like legal or comedic, as this can bring a unique quirk to your character and influence your performance. 

We want to work with your film character, customized to your abilities. 

Please feel free to share this opportunity with your professional network. And if you'd like to bring to a friend along with you on-set, the more the merrier. Low time commitment, footage for your reel, and a great opportunity to connect. 

We look forward to reviewing your submissions!

CASTING NOTICE: MOUNT VERNON’S FAVORITE SON

I am excited to announce that we are now casting day players for our independent short film, Mount Vernon's Favorite Son.

We are seeking performers of any experience who are ready to bring professionalism and energy to the set. This is an excellent opportunity for actors and non-actors looking to build their resume and collaborate with a passionate local production team based in Mount Vernon, New York.

Available Roles: Dialogue-driven rideshare/taxi passengers. For various ages and backgrounds. 

Submission Process: Please email mountvernonsfavoriteson@gmail.com with your headshot, resume, portfolio, and especially any skill sets you'd like to show off. Skills can include musical or dance, or vocational backgrounds like legal or comedic, as this can bring a unique quirk to your character and influence your performance. 

We want to work with your film character, customized to your abilities. 

Please feel free to share this opportunity with your professional network. And if you'd like to bring to a friend along with you on-set, the more the merrier. Low time commitment, footage for your reel, and a great opportunity to connect. 

We look forward to reviewing your submissions!

Hello everyone! We’re casting David and Bridget for our upcoming short film ***Boarding Home***. (ONLY LOCAL TALENT WILL BE ACCEPTED)

**Logline:** When a hopeful young woman arrives at a boarding home to visit a friend, her attempts to help the people living there catch the attention of a quiet, dejected mechanic who starts questioning why she’s really there.

We’re looking for actors who connect with the characters and are looking for something interesting to play. If David or Bridget catches your attention, we’d love to see your audition.

**Casting Details:**
**Non-Union | Unpaid | Meals Provided on Set | IMDb Credit | Professional Reel Footage**
**Shooting Date:** Saturday, November 7, 2026
**Audition Dates:** October 25–29

**Shooting Location:** Toronto, Ontario, Canada

**Interested?** Please send your headshot, resume, and demo reel to jonosei@horizondreamproductions.ca.

It would be an unpaid collaboration. Would you be interested and available to film in Santa Barbara? Let me know what equipment you have!

⚔️ CASTING CALL: SOLDIERS WANTED
DEFIANCE recreates the December 28, 1835 ambush of Major Dade's column, the battle that sparked the Second Seminole War. We're filming on the historic ground where it happened.

We're looking for: Men, ages 20-35, to play U.S. Army infantry and artillery in Dade's column. Athletic, driven, and ready for action. You'll bring the grit and intensity of 1830s warfare to the screen.

Pay: Paid, non-union

Filming:

Jan 29-31, 2027: Fort King (Ocala)

Feb 1-2: Fort Foster (Thonotosassa)

Feb 3-13: Boyd Hill Nature Preserve (St. Petersburg)

Ready to step onto the battlefield? Email Karolina at 3ratsentertainment@gmail.com with your headshot, height/sizes, resume, and contact info.

Tag a friend and share this post. We need soldiers!

3 Rats Entertainment LLC & Avail Entertainment LLC

Casting Call - feature film
We are currently looking for a male presenting actor (Age range of 25 - 35). It's a dual role, playing a pair of twin vampire henchmen for our horror comedy, Love In Vein. 

Our next shoot is 15th November, in Brighton, and will recur on the odd weekend moving forward. The project has been pieced together though both cast and crew kindly volunteering their time to bring the project to life on weekends, so it's unpaid at present. We do cover expenses though such as food, travel and accommodation. We understand the prioritisation of paid work, so we'll work around you. We can also to offer any creative exchange such as headshots, editing casting reels and filming audition tapes. 

Teaser Trailer to the film below! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ua2hzPuj770

Synopsis of the Film 

Love in Vein follows Evelyn and Peter. Evelyn is a vampire with a heart, using a dating app called WinkedIn to lure men in. She never kills them though, only taking what she needs. Peter is a mild-mannered photography student, looking for love. Using WinkedIn, he ends up on a date with Evelyn. A romance between the two is ignited and both of their worlds turn upside down, soon to be further complicated by a spector of Evelyn’s past… 

If you're interested, please drop an email to: 

loveinveincasting@gmail.com

Thanks and looking forward to hearing from some of you!

Szukamy osób do krótkiego nagrania na social media!

Poszukujemy osób do udziału w rolce promującej kabanosy/ wyroby wędliniarskie. Nagranie będzie miało formę krótkiej, swobodnej sondy – do powiedzenia będą dosłownie 1–2 zdania na temat produktu i pokazanie naturalnej, pozytywnej reakcji na jego otrzymanie.

Nie wymagamy doświadczenia przed kamerą, zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności i swobodzie wypowiedzi.

Wynagrodzenie: 80 zł za ok. 20 minut.

📍 Miejsce: Wrocław

📅 Termin: 5 listopada, w nagrania w godzinach  10:00–15:00 (do uzgodnienia)

Przed nagraniem konieczne będzie podpisanie zgody na wykorzystanie wizerunku w materiałach publikowanych w mediach społecznościowych marki.

Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o wiadomość prywatną wraz z aktualnym zdjęciem.

🎬 WHEN IT GOES QUIET, CHECK THE CALENDAR 🎬

When you question why times are quiet and if you should stay in the game... check the calendar.

Instead, navigate what you and/or your agent can do to make the most of busy or quiet months.

That’s why I made a general UK acting industry calendar for a year. When productions are green-lit, and when it goes quiet.

Because quiet months aren’t a sign you’re failing. They’re part of the cycle. We all feel them.

📌 JAN — Reset, green-light, continuing dramas book
📌 FEB/MAR — Indie film & theatre cast
📌 APR/MAY — Day player peak
📌 JUN/JUL — Shoot season, breakdowns dip
📌 AUG — Quiet month, CDs away
📌 SEP/OCT — Second green-light, best time for agent meetings
📌 NOV — Last push for winter storylines
📌 DEC — Industry shuts down

#UKActor #BritishActor #SpotlightActor #ActorLifeUK #SupportBritishActors

items.text:
CASTING LONG MÉTRAGE – « UNE FLEUR SANS NOM » – Inspiré d'une histoire vraie – Région parisienne

Il lui a envoyé des roses. Sans carte. Sans nom.
Il savait parler devant des salles entières, mais pas dire trois mots à une seule personne.

« Une fleur sans nom » est un long métrage indépendant d'environ 95 minutes, adapté du livre du même nom et inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Une histoire d'amour, de silence et de foi, racontée par deux voix : celle d'un jeune homme de 19 ans, et celle de la rose qu'il a envoyée.

Le film est produit par l'association culturelle All With Heart, avec une ambition claire : le cinéma.

NOUS RECHERCHONS

Rôle principal
• LINA, 18-22 ans. Lumineuse, sensible, pleine d'humour. Elle reçoit les roses et cherche le visage qui se cache derrière. Un regard qui dit tout.

Rôles secondaires
• NADIA, 40-50 ans. La mère de Farès. Discrète, elle voit tout sans rien dire.
• YANIS, 18-23 ans. Le meilleur ami de Farès, le comique de la bande. Le sens du rythme est indispensable.
• ILYES, 18-23 ans. L'autre ami, calme et profond, celui à qui l'on se confie.
• CLAIRE, 42-52 ans. La mère de Lina, sa confidente.
• KARIM, 45-55 ans. Le père de Lina. Protecteur, et maladroit quand il mène sa propre enquête sur les roses.
• NOAM, 16 ans à l'écran (rôle réservé à un comédien majeur). Le petit frère de Lina, malin, le premier à soupçonner Farès.
• THÉO, 18-23 ans. Un garçon de la troupe, dont Farès est jaloux.
• ADAM, 19-24 ans. Celui qui ose dire « tu me plais ».
• LE FLEURISTE, 30-65 ans. Peu de scènes, mais un rôle clé : c'est lui qui tend la petite carte blanche.

Figuration
• De nombreux figurants, notamment pour la troupe d'une comédie musicale. Chant ou danse bienvenus.

Aucun critère physique ni d'origine. Les âges sont indicatifs, et les prénoms des personnages peuvent évoluer selon les comédiens retenus. Débutant ou confirmé, ce que nous cherchons avant tout, c'est la sincérité.

LE PROJET
• Tournage majoritairement en région parisienne.
• Projet associatif non rémunéré. Chaque participant signe une convention de bénévolat et une autorisation d'exploitation de son image et de son interprétation.
• Ce que tu reçois : un rôle dans un long métrage pensé pour le cinéma, ton nom au générique, les images de tes scènes pour ta bande démo, une invitation à l'avant-première, et une équipe exigeante et bienveillante.

POUR CANDIDATER
Inscription uniquement ici : https://casting-une-fleur-sans-nom.vercel.app/
Prépare une photo portrait en lumière naturelle et, si tu peux, une vidéo verticale d'une minute maximum où tu joues un texte de ton choix.

Pendant des semaines, il a envoyé des fleurs sans nom. Cette fois, nous signons.
Une fleur sans nom. Rien de ce qui est beau n'attend.

CASTING CALL | SHORT FILM
INTO THE WOODS

Winsford Films is seeking cast for an upcoming independent horror/sci-fi short film, Into The Woods, written by D.B. Madden. Set in the 1980s, this is a retro inspired film. The project is being produced as a proof-of-concept short for a planned feature film adaptation currently in development. This short is to be filmed over two days in mid December in the north west of England.

This is an excellent opportunity for performers seeking strong screen material and the potential to continue with the project as it progresses to feature-film development.

Please note: This is an unpaid production; however, all reasonable travel and on-set expenses will be covered. Cast members selected for the short film will be given priority consideration for their respective roles in the planned feature adaptation.

Into The Woods follows four young friends on a camping trip that takes a terrifying turn after a mysterious object crashes deep within the forest, unleashing something far beyond their understanding.

ROLES

DEBBIE

Female | Playing Age 20-27

Confident, intelligent and strong-willed. Debbie has a sharp sense of humour and a warm nature but is not afraid to speak her mind. Requires an actor capable of delivering both naturalistic dialogue and emotional depth.

SAM

Male | Playing Age 20-30

Charismatic, easy-going and likeable. Dennis masks a deeper level of responsibility beneath his relaxed exterior. Strong chemistry and believable relationship work required.

NIGEL

Male | Playing Age 20-30

Good-hearted, adventurous and impulsive. Nigel's curiosity ultimately drives the group into danger. Looking for a performer with strong screen presence and natural charm.

Lizzy

Female | Playing Age 20-30

Independent, witty and grounded. Lizzy possesses a quiet confidence and intelligence that anchors the group. Requires a strong dramatic performer.

PRODUCTION DETAILS

Production: Into The Woods

Genre: Retro Horror / Science Fiction / Thriller

Location: North West England

Production Company: Winsford Films

Compensation: Unpaid

Expenses: Travel and on-set expenses covered

Feature Film Potential: Actors cast in the short film will be considered first for corresponding roles in the planned feature film development.

SUBMISSIONS

Please send:

• Headshot

• CV (if available)

• Showreel or self-tape (if available)

• Current location

• Contact details

Email: Lancashirechriswork@outlook.com

Subject Line: INTO THE WOODS CASTING

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Hello! My name is Shweta Walia and I am a co-producer of an upcoming short South Asian Film called “The Ideal”.
We're looking for some (Production Assistants) PAs to be featured in this film! The team is looking for those who are curious being on a professional film set, and can help on set. PAs with prior experience preferred. High Schoolers interested in film making are also encouraged to apply. 
Please see flyer for details. 

We will be shooting Nov. 12th -15th in various locations in Northern VA (Reston, Herndon, Ashburn etc.) and we will provide food as well. If interested, please email treelineproductions1204@gmail.com with the email subject: Interest as PA - NAME, or DM us @treelineproductions!

About the Film
The Ideal is a short family drama about two South Asian American brothers who reunite
following the death of their mother. One brother left home to pursue professional success, while
the other stayed behind and became their mother's primary caregiver. Over the course of their reunion, years of unspoken resentment surrounding family, sacrifice, and success begin to surface.

Dans quelques semaines ou jours ce sera la toute  première de Smiley  et le coeur commence à battre 😀
Nous serons ravis de vous compter parmi nos spectateurs pour nous soutenir et vibrer avec nous !!

 Vous pourrez assister à la rencontre de Bruno et Alex au Théâtre A la Folie Théâtre 75011 Paris. 
Les représentations  auront lieu tous les Jeudis, Vendredi et Samedi à 21h30 et ce jusqu'au 30 Janvier !!!!
Smiley est une comédie romantique drôle et touchante que nous avons adapté de l'espagnol  avec mon partenaire de scène Nicolas Desnoues.
Smiley c'est aussi  un reflet sans fard sur les hasards et les difficultés des rencontres sur les réseaux et autres applications.
Bruno et Alex n'ont à priori rien en commun, aussi bien dans leur mode de vie que dans leurs centres d'intérêts.
A la suite d'un quiproquo ils vont se rencontrer.
Et si, malgré leurs différences, ils étaient fait pour vivre une belle histoire? 

Si également vous pouvez diffuser l'information autour de vous , ce sera notre meilleure publicité 😉
Merci par avance !

A très très bientôt !!!

Pascal Seguin 😃

🎬 **CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW**
**8 OPENINGS | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

We're looking for new actors and performers to join *The Bros Show*, an independent South London teen comedy series full of chaos, banter, unexpected situations and mockumentary-style humour.

We're currently casting **seven character roles and one background role**. If you're interested in acting and want to be part of an independent production, we'd love to hear from you!
🎭 ROLES AVAILABLE

**1. Posh Bird 1**
A confident, fashionable and outspoken character with attitude, personality and plenty of banter.

**2. Posh Bird 2**
Playful, mischievous and outspoken. Someone who can bring humour and stir things up in a scene.

**3. Posh Bird 3**
A character in the Posh Birds group who needs a confident performer with natural reactions, expressive acting and good comic timing.

**4. Posh Bird 4**
A cocky, flirty, unpredictable wildcard who brings plenty of attitude and tension, particularly around Lainey. Needs confidence, humour and strong on-camera presence.

**5. Lainey**
A recurring character who is confident, cheeky, flirty, funny and unpredictable, with a softer, caring side beneath the attitude. She has a long history with Aweys and her own personality, relationships and storylines.

**6. Officer Thompson / PC Thompson**
A believable police constable who can deliver dialogue clearly, react naturally to the Bros' ridiculous behaviour and balance authority with comedy.

**7. Auntie 2**
Part of the auntie duo. We're looking for an expressive performer with personality, natural delivery and good comic timing.

**8. Episode 5 Background Performer**
A background role for Episode 5. Ideal for someone comfortable appearing on camera, following direction and helping bring the scene to life.
🎬 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
* Natural acting and believable reactions.
* Confidence and good comic timing.
* Reliability and willingness to learn lines where required.
* Ability to take direction and work as part of a team.
* Enthusiasm for an independent comedy project.

Acting experience is welcome, but we're also open to promising newcomers.
📍 LOCATION

**South or West London.**

Applicants must be able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations. Specific dates and locations will be discussed before anyone commits.
💷 PRODUCTION DETAILS
* This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.
* Travel, food and other expenses are **not guaranteed**.
* Filming dates, expectations and role details will be discussed in advance.
* Applicants under 18 must have a parent or guardian involved in the process.
📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send:
1. Your preferred name and age.
2. Your general location (South or West London).
3. Which role or roles you're interested in.
4. A recent photo.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous performance clips, if available.
6. Your general availability.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a self-tape audition with a deadline agreed in advance. If you need an extension, please contact us before the deadline.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

We're looking for people who want to get involved, work together and help bring a unique independent comedy series to life.

🎥 **THE BROS SHOW — EIGHT OPENINGS. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, send us a message to apply!

🎬 SCHAUSPIELER & CREW GESUCHT: Darsteller und Helfer für Independent-Horrorfilm gesucht! 🩸

Du liebst Horrorfilme und wolltest schon immer mal bei einem echten Langfilm dabei sein? Das Drehbuch steht bereits, und wir planen einen abendfüllenden **Horrorfilm mit ca. 60 Minuten Laufzeit**!

Dafür suchen wir ein engagiertes Team, das Lust hat, dieses große Projekt gemeinsam auf die Beine zu stellen.

**WICHTIG VORAB:** Da es sich um ein reines Hobby- und Independent-Projekt handelt, gibt es **kein Geld**. Der Spaß an der Sache, das gemeinsame Kreieren, Teamgeist und die Leidenschaft für das Filmemachen stehen absolut im Vordergrund! Perfekt, um Erfahrungen zu sammeln und Material für das eigene Portfolio zu gewinnen.

👥 Wen wir suchen:

**🎭 DARSTELLER & SCHAUSPIELER (m/w/d)**
* **Alter:** 18 bis 60 Jahre
* **Aussehen:** Völlig egal! Ob dick, dünn, groß oder klein – wir suchen echte Charaktere.
* **Erfahrung:** Absolut keine Vorerfahrung nötig! Auch Anfänger und Unerfahrene sind herzlich willkommen.

**🎥 CREW & HELFER hinter der Kamera:**
* **Kamera-Leute:** Du hast eine eigene Kamera und ein Auge für düstere Bilder?
* **Maskenbild / Make-up:** Du hast Lust auf Kunstblut, Spezialeffekte und Grusel-Make-up?
* **Organisation / Set-Allrounder:** Du behältst bei einem längeren Projekt den Überblick?
* **Requisite / Besorger:** Du bist ein Organisationstalent und kannst Kleidung, Deko oder Requisiten organisieren, wenn am Set etwas gebraucht wird?

📍 Woher solltet ihr kommen?

Die Vorbereitungen und Dreharbeiten finden in der Region statt. Wir suchen Leute aus:
**Nürnberg | Fürth | Erlangen | Lauf | Röthenbach an der Pegnitz | Eckental | Eschenau | Neumarkt | Postbauer-Heng**

✨ Das erwartet dich:

Ein leidenschaftliches Team, eine Menge Erfahrung an einem echten Filmset und am Ende ein fertiger, einstündiger Film, auf den wir alle stolz sein können!

**Hast du Bock, Teil unseres Horror-Spielfilms zu werden?**
Dann schreib mir einfach eine Nachricht! Erzähle mir kurz, wer du bist und ob du vor oder hinter der Kamera dabei sein willst.

Wir freuen uns auf dich! 💀 🎬

Am besten feuert die Requisiten ihren mühsam Ranorganisierten Fundus für umme durch und bringt am Besten auch noch das Kunstblut mit..... Stimmt's?!?!!

Der Spaß an der Sache, das gemeinsame Kreieren, Teamgeist und die Leidenschaft für das Filmemachen stehen absolut im Vordergrund! Perfekt, um Erfahrungen zu sammeln und Material für das eigene Portfolio zu gewinnen.

👥 Wen wir suchen:

**🎭 DARSTELLER & SCHAUSPIELER (m/w/d)**
* **Alter:** 18 bis 60 Jahre
* **Aussehen:** Völlig egal! Ob dick, dünn, groß oder klein – wir suchen echte Charaktere.
* **Erfahrung:** Absolut keine Vorerfahrung nötig! Auch Anfänger und Unerfahrene sind herzlich willkommen.

**🎥 CREW & HELFER hinter der Kamera:**
* **Kamera-Leute:** Du hast eine eigene Kamera und ein Auge für düstere Bilder?
* **Maskenbild / Make-up:** Du hast Lust auf Kunstblut, Spezialeffekte und Grusel-Make-up?
* **Organisation / Set-Allrounder:** Du behältst bei einem längeren Projekt den Überblick?
* **Requisite / Besorger:** Du bist ein Organisationstalent und kannst Kleidung, Deko oder Requisiten organisieren, wenn am Set etwas gebraucht wird?

📍 Woher solltet ihr kommen?

Die Vorbereitungen und Dreharbeiten finden in der Region statt. Wir suchen Leute aus:
**Nürnberg | Fürth | Erlangen | Lauf | Röthenbach an der Pegnitz | Eckental | Eschenau | Neumarkt | Postbauer-Heng**

✨ Das erwartet dich:

Ein leidenschaftliches Team, eine Menge Erfahrung an einem echten Filmset und am Ende ein fertiger, einstündiger Film, auf den wir alle stolz sein können!

**Hast du Bock, Teil unseres Horror-Spielfilms zu werden?**
Dann schreib mir einfach eine Nachricht! Erzähle mir kurz, wer du bist und ob du vor oder hinter der Kamera dabei sein willst.

Wir freuen uns auf dich! 💀 🎬

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS
FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

TELEDYSK, BIELSKO-BIAŁA 12.11/13.11

Szukamy dziewczyny do jednej z ról kobiecych w teledysku rapowym. Postać to Justyna: pretensjonalna, teatralna i przerysowana, w stylu „ciżi”. Dużo emocji i komedii. Szukamy kobiet w wieku ok. 20-35 lat z poczuciem humoru, które nie boją się przesady przed kamerą.

Na czym polega rola: Justyna „śpiewa” tekst artysty, ale nie nagrywamy Twojego głosu. Uczysz się kilku słów piosenki, a na planie grasz śpiew do nagranego głosu artysty (playback) Liczy się aktorstwo, mimika i energia, a nie to, jak śpiewasz.

Termin i miejsce: zdjęcia 12 lub 13 listopada 2026 w Bielsku-Białej. Szukamy Kobiet z Bielska-Białej i okolic, może być też z Katowic.

Stawka: 500 zł płatne po planie

Zgłoszenia wysyłaj na karinaszymocha@gmail.com, w tytule maila wpisz „TELEDYSK”. 

W zgłoszeniu prześlij: imię i nazwisko, wiek, miasto, numer telefonu, 2-3 aktualne zdjęcia (portret i cała sylwetka) oraz wizytówkę wideo (link do YouTube)

Zgłoszenia bez wizytówki wideo nie będą rozpatrywane. Odezwiemy się do wybranych osób. 😊

We are now in Preliminary Casting for The Prodigal Daughter. 

Set to the Biblical parable of the Prodigal Son. Is a famous story about a father who welcomes back his rebellious younger son with joy, despite the son wasting his inheritance, while the faithful older brother remains resentful. 

This story sets the stage for a daughter (early 20's) who gets her inheritance share from her late grandmother, and she thinks she can make it on her own. 

Rather than listen to the wisdom of her parents, she is rebellious and moves into a small studio apartment and takes the false advice of those who she thinks are her friends. With the influence of her "friends" she soon squanders her inheritance, and ends up loosing her studio apartment, turns to a life of drugs and prostitution..
In a state of despair, she take a blade to slit her wrists and end her life. It is true a sheer act of redemption that she decides to return back to the family home to seek forgiveness from her parents.

A story that is gripping and shows the real struggles of many that are homeless and wanting a way home, through hope.

NOTE: ALL LEAD ROLES ARE NOW GONE. ONLY LOOKING FOR SUPPORT ACTORS. 

FILMING: BLACKPOOL AREA. APRIL 2027

items.text:
Movie idea:

Title: Myrmarachne

Main areas/ Movie shoot locations: Leamington, Warwick and Willenhall Coventry. 

Main genres: Psychological horror, fantasy

Age range: 18-21

Key points: Unpaid job or travel. This is a project designed simply for fun with people to make friends with who share the same interests with film acting. 

I'm looking for people who are talented enough 😉 to take part and show a beautiful presentation of the mixture of different emotions portrayed by the characters in order to create a life-like, real story and adventure through this surreal psychological thriller with connections to supernatural, spiritual and metaphysical concepts.

Important note: The earliest the movie will most likely start being filmed is late 2027/ early 2028. This is because even though I have the plot written, i still have to finish writing other pages including multiple scripts. I think that is plenty of time for us to use and spend by getting to know each other, diving and learning about your own individual characters, learning scripts, rehearsing scenes, going over the plot and making a new friend group.

Movie description: A group of teenagers and friends begin to experience bizarre occurences within their neighborhood. During a trip in the local woods, after getting lost within a muddle of different dimensions, and after making contact with several other-worldly creatures, out of fear and panic, they get split apart. At some point, after learning that part of the supernatural is connected to heavenly love, they eventually try and get together and escape the dangers within their world and enter the "higher realms."

To apply for a role, send me: Acting CV and personal showreel (if you have these).

Please send over a 1-3 minute long self-tape of your own choice. 

Personal details: Name, height, age, city/ town, headshot.

Any questions, you can message me personally.

Further details about the plot and overall project will be released in personal groupchats and messages for people who are interested.

50 Jahre nach Brian De Palmas CARRIE - jetzt als Serie von Mike Flanagan
In meinem neuen Text für artechock vergleiche ich De Palmas Film von 1976 mit Flanagans Serie von 2026.

Mich interessiert vor allem: Wie verändert sich die Demütigung, wenn sie nicht mehr nur im Schulflur passiert, sondern zum Bild wird? Früher hatte die Grausamkeit Zeugen. Heute hat sie auch ein Archiv.

De Palma verdichtet das Grauen, Flanagan weitet es aus.

Über Feedback und Diskussion würde ich mich freuen!

Hier der ganze Artikel: https://www.artechock.de/film/text/artikel/2026/10_29_carrie_50_jahre.html

#Carrie #StephenKing #BrianDePalma #MikeFlanagan #Filmkritik

.   🎭 OUVERTURE AUDITIONS SAISON 7 🎭
             Troupe amateur avec adhésion 
                  DONC NON RÉMUNÉRÉ 

➡️Auditions lundi 02/11 ou lundi 9/11/26 de 19h15 à 21h15 Lyon 2
( 15 min de passage avec 1 page de dialogues et 1 comédien qui vous donnera la réplique )

INFOS : https://www.lespendrillonsrouges.fr/page/4142138-auditions-2026-27
_____________________________________________

🎭 Pour sa prochaine comédie, la troupe de théâtre Lyonnaise Troupe Les Pendrillons Rouges recherche 4 comédiens :

                     " TOI TOI, MON TOIT "
                  Écriture & Mise en scène 
    Nicolas Bret-Morel & Rébecca Lisa Mantel 
 
SYNOPSIS :
2 appartements se font face, 2 univers qui s'opposent / 1 locataire aveugle et 1 propriétaire femme d'affaire.
La famille de Fabienne, famille style Tuche, part en vacances aujourd'hui avec ses enfants mais le loyer n'a pas été payé !
Sa voisine du dessus, Lauranne femme d'affaire, a tout fait pour avoir une image des plus brillante : appartement dernier étage, femme de ménage, baby-sitter ... 
Tout est sous contrôle ou presque ! 1 détail vient ternir ce tableau :
Elle veut récupérer l'appartement du dessous pour construire l'aboutissement de son rêve ultime : un duplex penthouse !
 _____________________________________________
 
➡️ Vous souhaitez intégrer une troupe de théâtre bienveillante qui s'éclate et qui cartonne sur Lyon ? 😊
Vous avez déjà une expérience théâtrale ou pas ? 
Vous souhaitez partager une très belle aventure humaine avec nous ?

Parfait ! C'est que cette annonce est faite pour vous mais seulement si vous faites preuve d'écoute, de bienveillance, de respect et de bonne humeur 🤗
 
➡️ Ne pas avoir peur ou être allergique aux chiens car cette année, une chienne guide d'aveugles sera avec nous tous les lundis et sur scène aussi.
Nous jouerons cette année pour l' Association de Chiens Guides d'Aveugles de Lyon et du Centre Est 
 _____________________________________________

PERSONNAGES RECHERCHES
 
👩 CYNTHIA : 
      Comédienne âge apparent 25 à 35 ans. 
      Rôle d'une baby-sitter très dynamique et un
      peu "simplette/naïve" parfois à côté de la
      plaque.
 
🙍AUREA : 
     Comédienne âge apparent 35 à 55 ans.
     Femme de ménage rock'n'roll. Personnalité
     haut en couleur et n'a pas sa langue dans sa
     poche !
 
🦰THIMOTHEE : 
     Comédien âge apparent 35 à 50 ans.
     Marié avec Sonia qu'il adore mais il a du
     mal avec son humour. Il se laisse mener par
     le bout du nez par sa femme.
 
🙍SONIA : 
     Comédienne âge apparent 35 à 50 ans.
     Femme de Thimothée. C'est une rigolote
     bourrue, un aplomb à tout épreuve,
     envahissante et qui ne manque pas de faire
    des blagues même si parfois ça tombe à
    plat. Forte personnalité et grosse énergie.
 _____________________________________________
 
⚠️ Répétitions OBLIGATOIRES salle Bayard tous les lundis à partir du 16/11/26 de 19h à 22h au 32bis cours Bayard 69002 Lyon, sauf vacances scolaires et jours fériés
 
🗓 La GÉNÉRALE le mercredi 22/06/27 de 10h à 17h
🗓 Représentations les 25, 26 et 27 juin 2027 à l' Acte 2 Théâtre  Lyon 9 
🗓 2 journées de répétitions générales à prévoir le dimanche 4 avril et samedi 04 juin 2027 au TH Métro Thmétro Ateliers  69002 Lyon
💰Adhésion annuelle de 250 €
_____________________________________________

POUR POSTULER :

📧 lespendrillonsrouges@gmail.com
👤 Nicolas BRET-MOREL : Président et metteur en scène 
📲 0786364953

Casting "Karol's Christmas," a student short film produced at the University of Greenwich. A darkly comic film about what happens when a beleaguered woman has finally had enough of her terrible family. Set during Christmas in a family living room, the film follows Karol, a quietly frustrated woman whose passion for playing the piano has long been overlooked by her family.

The tonal references include BBC's "Here We Go," "The Royle Family" and Channel 4's "Friday Night Dinner," combined with the darkly comic atmosphere of "Fargo."

Naturalistic British family comedy with strong comic timing, grounded characterisation and darker psychological undertones. Production welcomes applications from performers who are comfortable exploring the balance between domestic comedy, emotional tension and dark humour.

Shoots 25 Nov. (call time approx. 11 a.m.) at Omnibus Theatre, Clapham, London.

Unpaid/volunteer MA student (semi pro) short film; catering will be provided on set. Footage provided upon request.

Casting calls : football monopoly
We are casting for a football monologue in which the actor will be talking to camera in front of a large LED screen.  

we are searching for:

Male 50+

Female 30+

Male -

Captivating speaker, wise older voice. Gravitas and authority. Someone who could be a coach and hold the attention and respect of their peers.

Female -

Same but younger, maybe more about energy and enthusiasm alongside the gravitas and able to captivate attention

Shoot date: TBC - roughly mid nov. 

Location- Nottingham or London tbc 

Fee- £700 plus travel 

Usage: internal use

Apply :email a self tape to -Jordan.leeming@movingfolk.com 

Must have self tape 

Self tape lines : 

Our game never stands still

​How do you stay ahead?

Next fixture. Next hurdle.

Next competition. Next season.

Forward feels like the only option.

But the further you go

There’s less time and more pressure

Less support and more scrutiny.

# **“Can’t Take You Anywhere” Student Short Comedy Film**

When an entitled teenager attends a private business event with his parents, he fails to suppress his awkward and immature nature.

Looking for ￼3 actors for a 5 minute comedy!

Roles are not paid or promised.

JOHN: Supporting role of the frat-like CEO who helps Thomas (the teenager) make a terrible first impression with a girl seemingly his age. John is overconfident, loud, and raunchy. Looking for a male actor around his 40s.

MOM: Regular mom, mid 40s, who believed her son wouldn’t make a scene and is a supportive as possible for her husband and son.

DAD: Regular dad, also mid 40s, who knew that bringing Thomas was a bad idea. Dad’s goal is to secure a deal with John, the CEO.

We are also looking for plenty of extras for the business party scene.

We will be shooting around the first three weekends of November￼ around Denver, and are fairly flexible as it should be only 1-2 sets. If you are interested or have any questions, you can reach out to me at guinnico@gmail.com or 720-255-2717, and please include resumes/headshots/acting reels!

**Männliche Komparsen in Düsseldorf gesucht**

Hey zusammen, für die Social-Media-Accounts von SpeedDating XXL suchen wir Männer, die Lust haben, bei einem kurzen Content-Dreh mitzumachen.

Ort: Düsseldorf
Dauer: ca. 30 Minuten
Vergütung: 30 € pro Person
Zeitraum: November, den genauen Termin stimmen wir gemeinsam ab.

Dreherfahrung brauchst du nicht. Du solltest dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlen und damit einverstanden sein, dass die Aufnahmen auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen veröffentlicht werden.

Interesse? Dann schick uns gerne eine PN mit einer kurzen Vorstellung und schreib uns, an welchen Tagen und zu welchen Uhrzeiten du im November Zeit für den Dreh hättest. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du auch ein aktuelles Foto für die Auswahl mitschicken.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht!

**Statister søges til kortfilm i København! **

Hej, vi søger forskellige statister til vores afgangsfilm på Københavns film og fotoskole der vil blive filmet i København i uge 47!

Vi søger:

Gammelt ægtepar (60-80 år)

Mor med barnevogn (30–45 år)

Ungt kærestepar (25-30 år)

Gæster til fest (23-30 år)

Jobbet er desværre ulønnet, men vi sørger for snacks og noget at drikke! 

Mvh Valdemar Billing, Producer

Skriv til [valdemar.billing@gmail.com](mailto:valdemar.billing@gmail.com) for interesse eller mere info!

topComments.text: Hvis tiderne kan passe med mit arbejde kunne jeg være den ene halvdel af et ældre ægtepar😊

🎃 Looking for a fun Halloween plan this Friday? This event is for you!

Join Film Society Denmark for an evening of film trivia, charades and a lot of laughs at Meininger Hotel Copenhagen!

Come with friends or come solo. Everyone is placed in a mixed team, so it’s one of the easiest ways to meet fellow film lovers in Copenhagen and make friends!

What’s in store:
Film trivia: classics, blockbusters, world cinema
Movie charades: act or guess the right movie name
🏆 Prizes for the winning team, plus a special award for the best charades performance

Spots are limited, so book your ticket early. See you there! 🍿

Projekt: Werbevideos für FITprofil, eine App mit Band fürs Handgelenk (Berlin)

Gesucht: 3 Personen, Frau oder Mann, 55–75 Jahre, ganz normaler Typ, keine Kamera-Erfahrung nötig

Umfang: Band und App 7 Tage im Alltag nutzen, danach ca. 20 Minuten Aufnahmen mit dem eigenen Handy nach einer einfachen Anleitung. Kein Text zum Auswendiglernen: Gesagt wird nur, was für dich stimmt.

Drehort: bei dir zu Hause (Versand des Bands nach DE, AT oder CH)

Zeitraum: Auswahl bis 30.10., Versand ab 31.10., Aufnahmen bis 12.11.

Gage: 80 € nach Abnahme, dazu das Band zum Behalten und 1 Jahr FITprofil PRO

Verwendung: Online-Werbung (Social Media, Website, App Stores), 24 Monate, schriftliche Vereinbarung vorab. Gesicht und Stimme werden nicht mit KI verändert.

Bewerbung per PN: Alter, Wohnort, ein aktuelles Foto oder ein 10-Sekunden-Video, in dem du dich kurz vorstellst.

🎥 **LOOKING FOR A CAMERA OPERATOR / AUDIO ASSISTANT — L.A. COMIC CON THIS WEEKEND!**

Hey everyone! I’m putting together a small crew for **L.A. Comic Con this Friday, October 30th, through Sunday, November 1st**, at the Los Angeles Convention Center!

I’ll be attending with an industry pass and conducting interviews with some of the convention’s guests for my podcast, **Real Talk Underground**, and I’m looking for one or two people who’d be interested in helping out with filming.

**Here’s what I’m looking for:**
📸 Someone with a digital camera or video camera  
🎤 Ideally, someone who also has a microphone or audio recording equipment

**The best part?** You’ll receive a complimentary industry badge and free entry to the convention as part of the crew!

If you’re into photography, videography, podcasting, or just want to get involved in a fun media project, I’d love to hear from you.

🎬 **Here’s a video from last year to give you an idea of what we’ll be doing!** https://youtu.be/q5dYQc6jbu8?si=aYhl5o-qEr3alZHf

**Interested?** Drop a comment below or send me a DM and let me know what equipment you have and which days you’re available!

Feel free to share this post with anyone who might be interested. Thanks, everyone! 🤘

EXTRAS NEEDED THIS SUNDAY FOR AN UPCOMING SHORT FILM!
We are looking for extras to participate in the filming of AMERICAN, a short film about an evangelical congressman who after helping pass a harsh deportation order, views about politics and religion began to collide, and it forces him to make a decision. 

We are filming a political debate scene THIS SUNDAY, November 1, and we need a large, diverse audience! We are looking for people of all ages, ethnicities, and backgrounds to help bring this scene to life.

Filming Details:

Date: This Sunday, November 1, 2026
Call Time: 1:00 PM
Location: Houston Christian University, Houston, TX

No acting experience is necessary! This is a volunteer opportunity, and participants will receive IMDb credit.

If you’re interested in being part of a film production, we’d love to have you join us!

To participate, join our GroupMe for instructions and additional details:

GroupMe Link:

https://groupme.com/join_group/118328293/XzRf2qvt

Please share this post with your family, friends, and anyone who may be interested. We need as many people as possible to make this scene a success!

🎬 **CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW**
**8 OPENINGS | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

We're looking for new actors and performers to join *The Bros Show*, an independent South London teen comedy series full of chaos, banter, unexpected situations and mockumentary-style humour.

We're currently casting **seven character roles and one background role**. If you're interested in acting and want to be part of an independent production, we'd love to hear from you!
🎭 ROLES AVAILABLE

**1. Posh Bird 1**
A confident, fashionable and outspoken character with attitude, personality and plenty of banter.

**2. Posh Bird 2**
Playful, mischievous and outspoken. Someone who can bring humour and stir things up in a scene.

**3. Posh Bird 3**
A character in the Posh Birds group who needs a confident performer with natural reactions, expressive acting and good comic timing.

**4. Posh Bird 4**
A cocky, flirty, unpredictable wildcard who brings plenty of attitude and tension, particularly around Lainey. Needs confidence, humour and strong on-camera presence.

**5. Lainey**
A recurring character who is confident, cheeky, flirty, funny and unpredictable, with a softer, caring side beneath the attitude. She has a long history with Aweys and her own personality, relationships and storylines.

**6. Officer Thompson / PC Thompson**
A believable police constable who can deliver dialogue clearly, react naturally to the Bros' ridiculous behaviour and balance authority with comedy.

**7. Auntie 2**
Part of the auntie duo. We're looking for an expressive performer with personality, natural delivery and good comic timing.

**8. Episode 5 Background Performer**
A background role for Episode 5. Ideal for someone comfortable appearing on camera, following direction and helping bring the scene to life.
🎬 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
* Natural acting and believable reactions.
* Confidence and good comic timing.
* Reliability and willingness to learn lines where required.
* Ability to take direction and work as part of a team.
* Enthusiasm for an independent comedy project.

Acting experience is welcome, but we're also open to promising newcomers.
📍 LOCATION

**South or West London.**

Applicants must be able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations. Specific dates and locations will be discussed before anyone commits.
💷 PRODUCTION DETAILS
* This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.
* Travel, food and other expenses are **not guaranteed**.
* Filming dates, expectations and role details will be discussed in advance.
* Applicants under 18 must have a parent or guardian involved in the process.
📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send:
1. Your preferred name and age.
2. Your general location (South or West London).
3. Which role or roles you're interested in.
4. A recent photo.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous performance clips, if available.
6. Your general availability.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a self-tape audition with a deadline agreed in advance. If you need an extension, please contact us before the deadline.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

We're looking for people who want to get involved, work together and help bring a unique independent comedy series to life.

🎥 **THE BROS SHOW — EIGHT OPENINGS. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, send us a message to apply!

items.text: Why do most moms get an agent instead of doing gigs themselves?

topComments.text: My son was working very regularly and frequently without an agent. He booked some ads, commercials, tv shows, and even did a Super Bowl commercial. I would consider myself really exceptional at finding jobs with limited resources. Ultimately, it was those jobs and experience that got him an agent in the first place, but with an agent, you have access to audition for jobs that you NEVER see on any public forum. With his agent, he is auditioning for bigger projects on major networks that are never posted publicly. I also have to do less work and research. I don't have to spend hours each week looking for jobs and sending emails because our agent sends us the roles my son is right for. All we do are the self tapes and upload them to the sites. I feel like he has more opportunities with an agent than without one, but that's our experience.

1. Because it is illegal in many states (including CA) for parents to negotiate an employment contract for another person without a license (that's a form of slavery). 

2. Because 99% of the decent jobs are not visible to the public. They are listed on professional casting sites, used only by agents, managers, and casting directors. 
If they were listed to the public casting directors would get overwhelmed with newbies, they would have a harder time negotiating the contract with a parent who knowns nothing.   
That wastes their time. 

3. Reps are a form of screening. Casting Directors know that an actor has been seen, judged and chosen by someone. It narrows the talent pool to the most likely candidates for the job. 

4. Because agents know what they are doing. They can read the details of the breakdowns, read who the directors and CDs are, understand the budgets and union contracts. It is very similar to a real estate agent. Would you negotiate that giant 500 page sales agreement by yourself? No escrow, no agent? Probably not. It is risky. Talent agents are the same -- they have a vast knowledge of how to present actors, how to negotiate their deals so you don't get ripped off. 

5. Avoid scams. Agents are your protection against all sorts of predators in this industry. And I promise you -- there are many.

BTW, you might think you are on a professional site, like say Breakdown Services or Casting Networks. Both of those are industry standard but they have two different portals. Casting Directors can choose whether they want their job notice to be shown to everyone, or just to professionals. If you see a job on the actor side of CNI, or on Actors Access (the actor portal for Breakdown Services) it means one of three things: 
--the CD is wiling to take a newbie or a non-actor 
--they are looking for something really unusual (a 7 year old who appears to be 4, or an Asian kid with orange hair who speaks German)
--they are being paid by the studio to do a publicity stunt and say they saw 5 billion people.   

All the rest, and most of the union jobs (the higher paying jobs) are visible only to licensed agents and managers.

Illusive Paradigm Productions is expanding our talent network, and we want YOU to be part of it!

We’re a Baltimore-based production company dedicated to creating captivating, thought-provoking films, entertainment, and original productions that challenge perspectives, tell powerful stories, and give talent a stage to shine!

🎭 Actors & Actresses (All Experience Levels)

🎤 Comedians & Entertainers

💃🏾 Dancers & Performers

🎶 Musicians & Vocalists

📸 Models & Content Creators

🌟 Aspiring Talent Ready to Be Discovered!

📍 BALTIMORE & DMV TALENT, WE DEFINITELY WANT YOU!

But we’re not stopping there! We’re building a NATIONWIDE talent network, with plans to bring productions and casting opportunities to different states.

Not in Maryland? Don’t let that stop you! Get registered now so you’re already in our network and can be considered when opportunities become available in your area!

Whether you’re experienced or just getting started, we want to connect with passionate, dedicated individuals ready to bring their talents to life.

🎬 WHERE ARE ALL MY ACTORS, PERFORMERS & CREATIVES?! 🎭
YOUR TALENT DESERVES TO BE SEEN!

Illusive Paradigm Productions is expanding our talent network, and we want YOU to be part of it!

We’re a Baltimore-based production company dedicated to creating captivating, thought-provoking films, entertainment, and original productions that challenge perspectives, tell powerful stories, and give talent a stage to shine!

🎥 WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

🎭 Actors & Actresses (All Experience Levels)

🎤 Comedians & Entertainers

💃🏾 Dancers & Performers

🎶 Musicians & Vocalists

📸 Models & Content Creators

🌟 Aspiring Talent Ready to Be Discovered!

📍 BALTIMORE & DMV TALENT, WE DEFINITELY WANT YOU!

But we’re not stopping there! We’re building a NATIONWIDE talent network, with plans to bring productions and casting opportunities to different states.

Not in Maryland? Don’t let that stop you! Get registered now so you’re already in our network and can be considered when opportunities become available in your area!

Whether you’re experienced or just getting started, we want to connect with passionate, dedicated individuals ready to bring their talents to life.

📩 INTERESTED IN JOINING OUR TALENT NETWORK?

COMMENT BELOW OR SEND US A DM to receive our official Talent Registration Form and get added to our network for consideration in future opportunities!

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS
FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

* TIFFANY BELMONT (16+) — Miss Brooks’ stylish, ambitious, outspoken, and hilariously unpredictable assistant.

* BROOKLYN (16+) — The rival airline CEO’s daughter, whose loyalty begins to shift toward Diva Airways.

* SABRINA (25+) — A hardworking, loyal airline lounge manager confronting the company’s financial challenges.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue and bring a current headshot and acting résumé. Performers will also participate in group improvisation activities.

CALLBACKS — BY INVITATION ONLY

Friday, November 13, 2026 | 10:00 AM

Pullman Branch Library

11001 S. Indiana Avenue

Chicago, IL 60628

REHEARSALS & PERFORMANCES

Rehearsals Begin: January 10, 2027

Technical Rehearsals: April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement: April 8 – May 30, 2027

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please note: West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with or a sponsor of this production.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!

[Casting Call] Hot Singles Needed for Dating App Promo Video (Paid, SF Bay Area)
Hi everyone! We are casting for a lifestyle promo video and street interview shoot for a dating app in the SF Bay Area. We are currently looking for:
Role: Single Female & Single Male (Cast individually or paired on-site).
Age Range: 28-45 years old.
Ethnicity: White (for the single female) / Open or matching requirements.
Requirements: Athletic/fit build, attractive, high energy, outgoing, native English speakers, and comfortable with dating/flirty street interview style lines.
General Project Details:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area (Outdoor/urban spots like streets, cafes, parks, and restaurants).
Shoot Time: Late October or Early November
Shoot Duration: Approx. 10 hours.
Compensation: Paid (Competitive rate, details shared upon application).
What to Expect:
Casual, authentic lifestyle interactions, street interviews, and fun dating app promotional clips.
How to Apply:
If you are interested, please send a PM or comment below with:
Recent photos / headshots (Full-body & close-up).
A short intro (Name, age, and your location in the Bay Area).
Contact info or social media handles (Instagram/Portfolio).
Looking forward to hearing from you!

46 year old Londoner seeks first horror role
46 year old German born Brit seeks first role

I’m 46 years old, German born, British citizen, no acting experience or qualifications…I’m not your stereotypical guy and I wouldn’t fit into just any role - looking for an opportunity to star in a small budget horror or drama. Everyone’s gotta start somewhere. No idea how to get into acting so…thought I’d post this. Any possible casting agents/directors looking for something different and wanting to give a nobody a shot do get in touch. Ps: Attention - I won’t pay any fees to protect myself from scammers. Any legitimate company or agency will give me a free audition. Besides, I’m broke so….don’t even try. (By the way - constant rejection (my middle name) and being laughed at is part of it…so laugh away. 😊 Doesn’t bother me, good for strength. London based. 

Thank you. Email: Deantbrandt23@gmail.com

I’m a nobody and everything at once. Let the world laugh at you, mock you, love you, hate you…even bully you…it’s all part of it. The great thing about acting is - you can be anything and anyone you want if you believe. One of the best Hollywood actors have been looked down on….some never had training even. Look were they are now - stay true to yourself no matter what. Don’t stop dreaming or you’re dead. I love the haters too…Peace and Love. ❤️ ☮️

Any legitimate company or agency will give me a free audition. Besides, I’m broke so….don’t even try. (By the way - constant rejection (my middle name) and being laughed at is part of it…so laugh away. 😊 Doesn’t bother me, good for strength. London based. 

Thank you. Email: Deantbrandt23@gmail.com

I’m a nobody and everything at once. Let the world laugh at you, mock you, love you, hate you…even bully you…it’s all part of it. The great thing about acting is - you can be anything and anyone you want if you believe. One of the best Hollywood actors have been looked down on….some never had training even. Look were they are now - stay true to yourself no matter what. Don’t stop dreaming or you’re dead. I love the haters too…Peace and Love. ❤️ ☮️
